title: Contact/changes puts updated contacts in created list
description: Contact/set supports updating displayName and blocked; when a contact is updated, its changed_at_counter advances. ChatContactChangesHandler calls get_changes_since_ordered which returns ALL changed rows (both inserts and updates) and the handler puts them all in the 'created' array, never in 'updated'. RFC 8620 §5.6 requires: created = objects that did not exist at sinceState; updated = objects that existed at sinceState but were modified. A client that already has a contact cached will receive that contact in 'created' after a displayName patch, causing it to think it is a new object. The contact store has no separate created_at_counter column to distinguish inserts from updates.
